capabilities: Apply built-in or custom thinking lenses to a note or text selection
Stream LLM responses into a side panel
Save a lens result as a linked note tagged #lens/<lens>
Configure Anthropic or any OpenAI-compatible provider, including local Ollama and LM Studio servers
Edit lens prompts and shared instructions in settings
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns that applying a lens sends the note (and by default linked notes) to the provider's API, and that non-Anthropic providers return responses without token-by-token streaming.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get an AI critique, strongest-form defense, or concretization of an idea in a note.

relations.evidence: Anthropic (Claude) (default): create or select a secret for your API key
hosted services like OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, or DeepSeek, and local servers like Ollama and LM Studio
relations.plugin: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, Ollama, LM Studio

requires.name: Anthropic or OpenAI-compatible provider API key
Ollama or LM Studio for local models

summary: AI thinking tool that sends a note or selection to an LLM to challenge, steelman, or concretize the idea, streaming the result into a side panel.
